name: wiser-method-devops
description: A WISER plugin for people who run their own servers: virtual machines, Docker workloads and light security. It ships one expert, DevOps Expert, and five skills, Prepare VM, VM Inventory, VM Configure, VM Security Audit and Deploy Workload, and one tool, vm-job.
